description: Table row types remain standalone composites while table boundaries enforce source constraints
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS diff_composite_holder CASCADE;
DROP DOMAIN IF EXISTS diff_valid_composite_item CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS diff_composite_item CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS diff_composite_item_renamed CASCADE;
sql: CREATE TABLE diff_composite_item (name VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER CHECK (quantity > 0), state TEXT DEFAULT 'new');
CREATE TABLE diff_composite_holder (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item diff_composite_item, items diff_composite_item[]);
INSERT INTO diff_composite_holder VALUES (1, ROW(NULL, -1, 'held')::diff_composite_item, ARRAY[ROW('array', 2, 'new')::diff_composite_item]);
SELECT (item).name, (item).quantity, (items[1]).name, (items[1]).quantity, pg_typeof(item), pg_typeof(items) FROM diff_composite_holder WHERE id = 1;

SELECT ROW(NULL, NULL, NULL)::diff_composite_item IS NULL AS all_null_is_null, ROW(NULL, 1, NULL)::diff_composite_item IS NULL AS partial_is_null, ROW(NULL, 1, NULL)::diff_composite_item IS NOT NULL AS partial_is_not_null, ROW('ok', 1, 'new')::diff_composite_item IS NOT NULL AS complete_is_not_null;
CREATE DOMAIN diff_valid_composite_item AS diff_composite_item CHECK ((VALUE).quantity > 0 AND (VALUE).name IS NOT NULL);
ALTER TABLE diff_composite_item RENAME COLUMN quantity TO amount;
ALTER TABLE diff_composite_item RENAME TO diff_composite_item_renamed;
SELECT (item).amount, (items[1]).amount, pg_typeof(item), pg_typeof(items) FROM diff_composite_holder WHERE id = 1;
